Mr. Lalit Sharma, learned counsel for the 
applicant.
2. Mr. Himanshu Sain, learned AGA, for the 
State of Uttarakhand.
3. The instant bail application is moved on 
behalf of the applicant – Gaurav Gupta @ Gopu, 
who is seeking bail in connection with FIR dated 
12.08.2024 bearing FIR No.287 of 2024, Police 
Station Haldwani, District Nainital, on the ground 
of long incarceration, which the applicant has 
suffered i.e. more than two years as he is 
languishing in jail since 13.08.2024. Learned 
counsel for the applicant submits that there are in 
total 29 prosecution witnesses and up till date only 
9 prosecution witnesses has been examined.
4. Let the State Counsel may get the 
instructions on whose part there is a delay in 
expediting the trial.
5. List this matter on 30.10.2026.
6. In the meantime, learned counsel for the 
applicant may also place on record the complete 
order-sheet.
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
 08.10.2026
